messages.text: Hi, can you refund a stainless toaster I bought on another store's website last week, and also refund my ceramic butter dish from my order here delivered 35 days ago? What does your refund policy cover?

messages.text:
I can't refund either item.

**Toaster:** This policy only covers items from orders placed with this shop (refund-policy/v2/scope). A toaster bought on another store's website isn't covered, and I can't refund it.

**Ceramic butter dish (order h427-o1):** Our records show the dish was received back. The order was delivered on 2026-10-12, so the refund deadline was 2026-11-11 10:00 UTC. A request must be made within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window). Your request is late, and the policy doesn't allow exceptions to the time limit, so I can't refund it.

**What the policy covers:**
- Orders with the status "delivered" (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders).
- Requests made within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window).
- Units the shop has received back (refund-policy/v2/return).
- The amount paid for each unit, not including shipping (refund-policy/v2/amount).
- Each unit is refunded once, to the original payment only (refund-policy/v2/remaining, refund-policy/v2/payment).
- Your confirmation and a staff member's approval (refund-policy/v2/approval).
